title: Higher cluster tilting objects in locally finite triangulated categories
summary: We study higher cluster tilting objects through covering functors from derived categories of hereditary algebras. The covering formalism reduces the existence problem to the equivariant problem of finding \(G\)-stable \(d\)-cluster tilting objects in \(d\)-cluster categories. For triangulated categories with finitely many indecomposable objects this gives a complete ADE existence criterion and explicit counting formulas.
